verdict.rationale: The only relevant item is the API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/. Its 'latest' path weakly implies that versioned API documentation exists, but nothing in the pack describes API versions or any deprecation policy. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable versioned contract was found. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API versioning (e.g., v1/v2 endpoints), a published deprecation/sunset policy, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
